matched.note: Brand site (Lebanon) product 'Meat Mortadella Olives - 2kg', the deli log that is sliced by weight; the catalog calls it 'Mortadelle Beef Aux Olives' while the brand's ingredient list starts 'Chicken and beef meat 75%'. Ingredients and nutrition transcribed from the page's ingredient and nutrition images (https://tanmia.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Meat-mortadella-with-olives-ingredients.jpg, https://tanmia.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/meat-mortadella-olives-nutrition-facts.jpg). The nutrition image prints 'Calorific value 105 Kcal/100g' and 'Calories from fat 145 Kcal/100g', which contradict each other and the 12% fat, so energy was left out. No separate allergen statement on the page; soy is from the ingredient list.

pictures.looks: one 2 kg mortadella log in red printed casing, plain white background, side view; a small green olive-branch graphic sits in the top right corner of the image

ingredients.text: Chicken and beef meat 75%; water; olives; potato starch; thickener: guar gum, processed eucheuma seaweeds, xanthan gum; salt; soy protein; sugar; flavouring; stabilizers: di and triphosphates; dextrose; hydrolysed vegetable protein; garlic; vegetable fat hydrogenated; flavour enhancer: monosodium glutamate; antioxidant: ascorbic acid; onions; spices; citric acid; vegetable oil; preservative: sodium nitrite (less than 0.01%); colorant: allura red.

diet_labels.label: halal
diet_labels.basis: Brand page: 'made with 100% pure halal meat'; 'HALAL' printed on the casing in the pack image
